notes.title: Fantasy Little Jobs is Now Available!
notes.content:
First of all, We would love to say thank you to all who supported us since day one. It was a rough but exciting journey to all of us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545788/b9d0ff8a5bad1b96741a05b54a953ab216403aff.png[/img]

We are excited for you to forge weapons, grill a delicious meal, prepare quests and refine your aiming with the bow.

Be careful what you drink…
